# CG-RES-003: Optional response property removed

An optional property was removed from a response schema.

**Why it matters:** In an open schema the field may now carry any value; in a closed one it can no longer appear.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.propertyRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Optional property "{property}" was removed from {where}.
>
> {explanation}
>
> **Fix:** Confirm that consumers do not read "{property}".

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: optional removed from open schema

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}, avatarUrl: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Optional property "avatarUrl" was removed from GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: optional removed from closed schema

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {id: {}, avatarUrl: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Optional property "avatarUrl" was removed from GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: required removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [x], properties: {id: {}, x: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {id: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Consumers that never read the field are unaffected.
